meta.plan: Generalni urbanisticki plan grada Zagreba (GUP), consolidated text
meta.version: Procisceni tekst 16 Oct 2025, incl. amendments SGGZ 16/07, 8/09, 7/13, 9/16, 17/24, 28/25
meta.note: Permitted uses extracted from the consolidated GUP text (articles 8–23, 32–33). Verify against the official text before legal use.

ancillary_uses.label_hr: ustanove zdravstvene zaštite i socijalne skrbi

limits: Ancillary content within a residential building: max 150 m2 GBP per plot for individual and low-rise; max 10% of GBP for high-rise (3)
In individual/low zones ancillary content may be in a separate auxiliary building (3)
Existing ancillary content above limits may stay, without enlargement (3)
prohibited: sadržaji koji bukom, mirisom i prometom ometaju stanovanje
S.prohibited_note: Existing prohibited uses may stay without expansion, tending to conversion (6).

M0.primary: balanced mix of residential, residential-business, business and public uses; single-use buildings allowed
permitted_uses: predškolske ustanove, škole, visokoškolske i znanstvene ustanove
sport i rekreacija u manjim dvoranama bez gledališta; sportsko-rekreacijska igrališta
garaže za potrebe bloka i javne garaže (if allowed by the decision)
limits: Hotels: max 75 beds (existing larger hotels may stay and be reconstructed without capacity increase; larger hotels only via UPU covering at least one block)
Block perimeter: conversion of residential buildings to purely business is not possible; conversion to residential-business (ground floor to business/public) is possible
prohibited: sadržaji koji zahtijevaju intenzivan promet ili ometaju stanovanje
M0.prohibited_note: Existing prohibited uses may stay without expansion.

M1.primary: predominantly residential; business uses that do not disturb housing
permitted_uses: prodavaonice robe dnevne potrošnje (max 500 m2 GBP)
društvene organizacije, udruge, kultura, vjerske zajednice
sport i rekreacija u manjim dvoranama bez gledališta; igrališta
ugostiteljski objekti (except night club, night bar, disco club)
limits: May be in a mixed building or a separate building in individual/low zones
In individual/low zones ancillary content: max 30% of GBP on the plot
Separate plot: preschools, schools, health, retirement homes, culture buildings, parks, playgrounds, sports-recreation; other listed uses on separate plots up to 1 ha
Retail-only content cannot be phase I of a building
prohibited: obrti s nepovoljnim utjecajem na okoliš
sadržaji koji zahtijevaju intenzivan promet ili ometaju stanovanje
M1.prohibited_note: Existing non-conforming content may stay without expansion.

M2.primary: business and residential; ground floor of business and residential-business buildings must be business (offices, shops, hospitality) or public/social use
permitted_uses: tržnice, gradske robne kuće, trgovine, trgovački centri, hoteli
limits: Shopping and supply centres: max 10% of parking needs at open ground level, rest within the building

subtypes.D6: visoko učilište i znanost, tehnološki parkovi (higher education, science, tech parks)
subtypes.D: all public/social uses incl. state and city administration, public institutions, political organisations, diplomatic missions with residence, congress centres, sports halls, fire stations

permitted_uses: građevine javne i društvene namjene i prateći sadržaji
predškolske i školske namjene on all D subtypes
hoteli do 100 ležaja as ancillary to administrative, health, religious uses and universities, on separate plots
kiosci i privremene građevine (except preschool and school), per mayor's rulebook
notes: Existing larger hotels may stay; UPU may reconsider larger hotels
Exception: Studentski kampus Borongaj allows ancillary service uses on separate plots

permitted_uses: industrijski, obrtnički, zanatski, gospodarski pogoni svih vrsta
poslovne, upravne, uredske i trgovačke građevine
ugostiteljske građevine i građevine za zabavu
prometne građevine, javne garaže, sportske građevine, rasadnici
istraživački centri, javne i društvene građevine
limits: Only economic activities that do not disturb the city environment (13(2)); see art. 25 for environmental restrictions

permitted_uses: poslovni, upravni, uredski, trgovački i uslužni sadržaji
proizvodnja bez negativnog utjecaja na okoliš
same ancillary list as I (shops, hospitality, garages, sports, research, fuel stations)
notes: Exception: Kajzerica K1 east of the railway allows URIHO complex
Exception: remaining K1 zone east of planned road, north of Avenija Dubrovnik, west of Zagrebački velesajam, and the Velesajam area allow residential and residential-business buildings

K2.primary: large shopping centres and large retail operations with significant urban impact

permitted_uses: any of I, K1, K2, T

notes: Listed as 4.6 in art. 8; arranged according to the basic use and site values/protection (art. 11(4))

permitted_uses: sportske dvorane, stadioni, zatvorene i otvorene sportske građevine s ili bez gledališta
limits: Complementary space: max 30% of total built GBP of the main use (45% in UPU Termalno kupalište Blato)
notes: Exception: Dom sportova / Stadion Maksimir zone allows business, retail, public garages, hospitality, hotels, public/social uses, tied to a public architectural competition
Exception: Mandlova south part allows R1 building

permitted_uses: manji prateći prostori (garderobe, sanitarije, manji ugostiteljski sadržaji)
gledališta only as part of terrain design, uncovered
limits: Zones under 5 ha: max total ancillary GBP 1000 m2 per 1 ha of landscaped sports area, proportionally less on smaller
Zones over 5 ha without UPU obligation: Hipodrom 100 m2/ha, Jazbina 400 m2/ha, Krvarić 200 m2/ha
Zones with UPU obligation: max total GBP of zone 5000 m2
Open pitches may be covered seasonally; ancillary buildings built at the same time or after the pitches

notes: Building, content and equipment set by urban rules (urbana pravila)
Exceptions: HNK extension below Trg Republike Hrvatske (underground only); public underground garages at part of Trg dr. Franje Tuđmana and between Matka Talovca and Josipa Hanuša streets
Existing buildings may stay; energy renovation and reconstruction allowed
Only equipment that strengthens the recreational function; extent decided by forest/nature authorities
Special regime where in protection system A/B or ecological network (art. 23(3))

limits: At least 70% green-blue surfaces (vegetation, natural terrain, water)
Natural terrain share on plot: min 40%
Max kis (floor-area ratio): 0.2, except minor infrastructure buildings

notes: Exceptionally, where urban rules say so: small public/social, hospitality and residential buildings, klijeti, composting sites, pet cemetery, sculptures and memorials
Existing buildings protected as monuments or named as especially valuable may be kept, reconstructed, renewed per heritage authority
For Ministry of Defence, Ministry of Interior, Croatian National Bank; governed by special regulations; other buildings of national importance possible

permitted_uses: uređaji za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda, spremnici za vodu, kanalizacija
transformatorske stanice, toplane i elektrane, obnovljivi izvori energije
građevine za sakupljanje i obradu otpada, komunalne djelatnosti, garaže
ulična mreža, trgovi, mostovi, parkirališta i garaže
tramvajska i željeznička mreža, kolodvori, stajališta, spremišta
biciklističke i pješačke površine, rješenja utemeljena na prirodi
benzinske postaje i punionice goriva, žičare, tržnice
notes: Exceptionally on separate plots: office and ancillary buildings tied to the main activity
Building over traffic areas only if justified via UPU
Glavni kolodvor / Trnje railway area: up to 40% mixed predominantly business possible after public competition and UPU
Watercourses with protective corridors, public parks and protective green along streams (V3, Z1, Z rules); small recreation areas (R2 rules)
Linear infrastructure and traffic buildings possible, priority to public, pedestrian, cycling traffic
Mandatory final provision of road (max 2 lanes) between Ilica and Prilaz baruna Filipovića, and tram network between Ozaljska and Horvaćanska cesta
No tall vegetation that would block mandatory infrastructure
Existing: Mirogoj with Gaj urni, Miroševec, Šestine, Granešina, Čučerje, Remete, Markuševec, Gračani, Resnik, Stenjevec, Gornje Vrapče, Sveta Klara, Jakuševec
New cemeteries planned west of Mirogoj and east of Miroševec
River Sava, standing waters, reservoirs on Medvednica streams
Floating port structures at Jarun istok, Lanište, Hendrixov most, Most slobode, Most mladosti

permitted_uses: otvorena igrališta za sport i rekreaciju
notes: Exceptionally buildings serving the water function, outside the 100-year flood wave and retention
All works on V1, V2, V3 need approval of the competent water authority
Plot may be formed and natural terrain located within, but no building, auxiliary building, parking or fence

M.primary: Na površinama mješovite namjene moguće je graditi i uređivati prostore iz mješovite – pretežito stambene (M1) i mješovite – pretežito poslovne namjene (M2). Namjenu pojedinih dijelova određuje urbanistički plan uređenja (UPU).
permitted_uses: prostori i sadržaji mješovite – pretežito stambene namjene M1 (čl. 10.b)
prostori i sadržaji mješovite – pretežito poslovne namjene M2 (čl. 11)
notes: U niskokonsolidiranim gradskim područjima potrebno je osigurati zelene površine prema člancima 82. i 83. (čl. 10(3))
Na područjima urbane preobrazbe površine igrališta za djecu određuju se programom za izradu UPU-a (čl. 10(4))
Iznimno, javna i društvena namjena može biti prevladavajuća unutar pojedinih područja sukladno smjernicama za izradu UPU-a (čl. 10(5))
Detailed permitted uses and prohibitions: see codes M1 and M2.

V.primary: Površine voda i vodnog dobra: V1 površine pod vodom, V2 površine povremeno pod vodom, V3 vodotok sa zaštitnim koridorom.
notes: Svi zahvati na površinama V1, V2 i V3 moraju biti u skladu s uvjetima nadležnog javnopravnog tijela (čl. 20(8))
Potoci se uređuju pretežito otvorenog korita; na osobito vrijednim područjima pejsažno, prema načelima renaturalizacije (čl. 20(5))
Na tekućim i stajaćim vodama i u njihovom okolišu treba očuvati postojeće biljne i životinjske vrste (čl. 20(6))

allowed_everywhere: biciklističke površine, pješačke staze, pješačko-biciklistički mostovi
manje infrastrukturne građevine (trafostanice 10(20)/0,4 kV, punionice za električna vozila)
everywhere.interim_use_note: Until the planned use is implemented, open spaces for public use (urban gardens, playgrounds, unpaved parking, dog parks) are allowed without buildings or tall vegetation that would block the plan.
everywhere.advertising_note: Advertising boards and mobile devices allowed in all zones per a separate city decision.

individualna.note: 3rd floor must be attic (potkrovlje) or setback floor (uvuceni kat)

niska.note: 4th floor must be attic or setback floor

zones: Z2 within protection system A or B
